mapper.select:
select id topicId, `topic`, ctime, uptime, `status`, cuid, opuid, `content` from corgi_topics where `status` != 'deleted'
and `status` = #{status}
and `topic` like concat('%',#{text},'%')
order by id desc
select topic from corgi_activity_topic where activity_id = #{activityId}

select message_type messageType, `content`, activity_id activityId, `to_user_id` toUserId, `from_user_id` fromUserId, `from_user_name` fromUserName, `from_user_avatar` fromUserAvatar, `is_read` isRead, `time` from corgi_activity_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = '0' order by `time` desc limit #{size}

select message_type messageType, `content`, activity_id activityId, `to_user_id` toUserId, `from_user_id` fromUserId, `from_user_name` fromUserName, `from_user_avatar` fromUserAvatar, `is_read` isRead, `time` from corgi_activity_message where to_user_id = #{userId} order by `time` desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select count(1) from corgi_activity_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = '0'
